Assignment Title: Food Delivery Order Management Using LinkedList

Assignment Question:
Food Delivery Order Management Using LinkedList
A food delivery application maintains the details of orders placed by its customers. Since orders can be added or cancelled at any time, the application uses a LinkedList to manage the orders. Each order contains an Order ID, Customer Name, and Order Amount. Write a Java program to read the number of orders and their details, store them in a LinkedList, remove a cancelled order based on its Order ID, display the remaining orders, and calculate the total order amount. The program should also display the first and last orders in the list. The program must perform necessary input validations: N must be greater than 0, Order ID must be a positive integer, Customer Name must not be empty, Order Amount must be greater than 0, and the Order ID to be cancelled must exist in the list. If any validation fails, display Invalid Input. 
 
 
Input Format
·       The first line contains an integer N, representing the number of orders.
·       The next N lines contain:
o   Order ID
o   Customer Name
o   Order Amount
·       The last line contains the Order ID of the order to be cancelled.
Output Format (For all valid inputs)
·       Display the details of the remaining orders, one order per line.
·       Display the first order.
·       Display the last order.
·       Display the total order amount.
If any input validation fails, display:  “Invalid Input”
 
Input Validation Conditions
·       N must be greater than 0.
·       Order ID must be greater than 0.
·       Customer Name must not be empty.
·       Order Amount must be greater than 0.
·       Order IDs must be unique.
·       The Order ID entered for cancellation must exist in the LinkedList.
Sample Input
4
101 Arun 450.50
102 Priya 320.00
103 Kiran 275.50
104 Meena 600.00
103
 
Sample Output
101 Arun 450.50
102 Priya 320.00
104 Meena 600.00
101 Arun 450.50
104 Meena 600.00
1370.50
